web.named_query: ("Brendan Carr" OR "Anna Gomez") AI artificial intelligence superintelligence policy statements

summary.text: On March 3, 2025, Carr expressed optimism that the AI technology revolution would benefit the economy. On August 7, 2024, Carr rejected a no-regulation approach to AI while warning against early overregulation and rules based purely on speculative harms. On December 17, 2025, Carr said the FCC would initiate a proceeding on potential federal AI reporting and disclosure standards and possible preemption, taking comments on all sides.
